question: Should the assigned owner refresh this test-only refactor against current `main` and approve it after confirming that the rebased suite still preserves all existing doctor-install scenarios?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and base drift must be assessed against the current test surface rather than the older branch base.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, verify the focused suite retains the intended scenarios, and merge the behavior-neutral cleanup.

options.title: Pause the refactor
options.body: Leave the existing explicit fixtures in place if the rebased diff obscures scenario-specific setup or increases review cost.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
recommendation.body: Rebase or refresh the merge result, verify the focused suite retains the intended scenarios, and merge the behavior-neutral cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: This person self-assigned the PR and authored the current refactor commit.
